findings.action: Regression from the N7 fix: with the root below the repository top, --relative also drops every change outside the root. A changed file at the top gives changed=[] and an empty selection with no error, in worktree and range mode, where the base engine selected the root and non-self-contained modules as a root-level change (reproduced against both versions of validate_scope.go). This narrows validation, against the stated widen-on-uncertainty rule, and no requirement or decision covers it. Reach: the shipped CLI resolves its root to the repository top (cli.go:440) and carry is off below it (by reading), so it affects callers that pass a lower root, the same reach as R1.

carryExclusions still lists top-relative names (no --relative) while the selection is now root-relative, so below the top administrative records are not excluded and widen the selection (seen in a direct probe). workingFileDiffersFromHead and scopeMetadataAt also use `show <head>:<path>`, resolved from the top. Latent and on the safe side: by reading, carry is refused below the top because root/.git is absent.

Text left behind by D1: R3 and R5 still name a report note bound that no longer exists, the len(files[0])>700 assertion cannot fail for a fixed note, the test comment and message still speak of a bounded note, and report.go:313-316 still describes a bounded, redacted line.

By reading: no test fails if the standard-error warning drops Git message, the second clause of R2. This test checks only the warning prefix, and TestTheReportStatesNoPath checks the returned error, not what is printed.
